desc:
Speaker: Hillel Wayne

You've used pytest and you've used mypy, but bugs are still slipping through your code. What's next? In this talk, we cover two simple but powerful tools for keeping your code problem-free. Property-based testing, provided by the [Hypothesis](https://hypothesis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) library, lets you run hundreds of tests from a single template. Contracts, via [dpcontra
